title: Hang Seng Index rises at noon on Monday, tech selloff eases
text:

 FINANCE 4 hours ago Sing Tao Hong Kong stocks rose by noon on Monday, as tech shares narrowed their losses.  
 ADVERTISEMENT SCROLL TO CONTINUE WITH CONTENT The benchmark Hang Seng Index rose 100 points, or 0.4 percent to 23,193 points by noon. The half-day market turnover was HK93 billion. 
 The Hang Seng Tech Index dropped by 0.4 percent to 3,857 points at noon.  
 In the mainland, the Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index slid 0.2 percent to 3,683 points, and the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Component Index declined 1.1 percent to 11,551 points.
